scope: Local diagnostic extension only. Source reconstruction and host verification; no runtime result, supported-candidate change or final acceptance.
motivation: The first diagnostic reaches mount callback entry for both absent private slot7 sources, but does not observe the queued native mount body or source-list publication.

local_reconstruction.base_guard: Reconstructs from frozen v3 linkfake.c SHA5ee62a2c8195260eca3cdc07210acdfa379bdb3e54e86c867230cc244a0b9835 and the exact three required package-asset hashes before creating output.

logging_contract.new_hook: 0x1c1f340: void(native_closure_payload*=x0). Native original is called exactly once with the identical pointer.
logging_contract.capture: Before forwarding, memcpy captures owner at+0, RootSourceID category/member/sdid/subkind at+8/+0xc/+0x10/+0x11, and unaligned original MediaID64 at+0x14. Payload is never reread after native execution.
logging_contract.stages: Entry and return timestamps plus full captured identities; exact-key root presence and mounted flag; bounded membership/count in currently registered source-list models. Listener/model pointers are reacquired independently for each stage.
logging_contract.limits: At most32 closure transactions per process; at most64 tree steps,8 root listeners and64 model rows per snapshot. Count/capacity, address-range, alignment and checked span guards reject inconsistent layouts. Used/scanned/source_models fields explicitly report the partial listener scan; source_models0 does not establish that no model exists beyond the first8 listeners.
logging_contract.effects: No native accessor calls, pointer publication, key mutation, return changes or extra execution of the original. Only existing logging and monotonic-clock calls are added. No claims overlap core-owned0x1c338d0 or0x1c373f0.

exact_firmware_layout_proof.trampoline: First16 bytes at0x1c1f340 are stp x29,x30,[sp,#-128]!; mov x29,sp; stp x19,x20,[sp,#16]; add x20,x0,#0x14. No branch or PC-relative operand is relocated. Native resumes at+16 with unchanged stack effects.
exact_firmware_layout_proof.tree: Native lookup0x1c1ed70 uses treebase=owner+0xe0 and calls insert0x1c26e28. That insert and0x1c26748 explicitly increment *(treebase+0x28), proving count at owner+0x108. Constructor0x1c211b8 independently zeroes param_1[0x21]. Root pointer is owner+0xf0; node left/right+0x10/+0x18; key+0x20; object+0x30; mount flag object+0x14=node+0x44. Equality follows native comparator0x1c10908: category, complete member32, sdid8.
exact_firmware_layout_proof.list: Native constructor0x1c313c8 places root-change listener at controller+0x18 with vtable0x2e0b4c0, and model at controller+0x80. Therefore only an exact matching listener vtable permits model=listener+0x68. Native model uses rows+8, capacity+0x10, used+0x18, row stride0x28 and RootSourceID at row+4.
exact_firmware_layout_proof.lifetime: The hook executes at the native body that mutates the root tree and synchronously calls its registered listeners on the native serialized root-set execution thread. The return snapshot relies on that existing root/model lifetime contract. It neither retains the native closure payload nor retains listener/model pointers across original execution; pointer/count guards are not represented as a general memory-safety proof for arbitrary addresses.
exact_firmware_layout_proof.readiness_failure: Existing make_hook rejection increments lf_hook_failures; the containing installer checks that counter before community_ready. If not ready, the closure forwards without observational reads. Existing hook-failure behavior is retained.
exact_firmware_layout_proof.local_raw_proof: slot7-final-list/root/listener/dataset-probe.out and slot7-closure-layout-probe.out under ignored local/diagnostics/link-normal-loader. Portable facts only are recorded here; raw firmware material remains ignored.

host_verification: Existing capability/mount fixture: private forced decisions, native result and all eight arguments unchanged, original exactly once, saturated budgets.

New closure fixture compiled with GCC -Wall -Wextra -Werror and ASan/UBSan: native overwrites payload, return log still uses captured full identities; root absent before and present/mounted after; exact source-list key membership before/after.

Distinct native USB2/player7/player8 identities with the same sdid do not compare equal; different sdid does not match. Cyclic tree stops after the bounded scan; invalid tree/vector/model counts and overflow addresses are rejected.
Saturated32-transaction and not-ready paths still forward original exactly once. Actual reconstructed community.c passes GCC SDK syntax with LF_EJECT_UI, LF_SAFE_EJECT and LF_EJECT_AZ.
Host fixtures replace only ARM high-address guards with fixture-allocation guards. The staged diagnostic retains original ARM address checks and actual layout/scan/forwarding bodies.
remaining: Independent package/build review, diagnostic runtime observation and causal interpretation remain separate. Any final functional acceptance must use an uninstrumented supported artifact; no production fix is inferred from this source record.
